## Preamble

By reference to "Poor man's" it means that the testing done is using hindcasting of data-rich [sic] age-based assessements. The idea is to use the analytical estimates of recruitment patterns, run those through hindcasting by applying some ~msy fishing pressure, use some age proxy for estimating contemporanous **"f"**, use biomass estimates to calculate the 2-over-3 ration (with or without adding noise), etc.

Currently, what follows below is just some gibberish for seeding.

```{r}
library(dlsrules)

# now cod
#  get data
rbx <-
  fishvice::mup_rbx("/u2/reikn/Tac/2022/01-cod/ass/mup/smx", scale = 1000)
rbx$rbya <-
  rbx$rbya %>%
  mutate(mat = replace_na(mat, 0),
         mat = ifelse(age >= 4, 1, 0),
         ssbW = cW,                    # 2022-05-28 from cW to sW as in paper
         ssbW = replace_na(ssbW, 0))
fls <-
  rbx %>%
  rbx_to_flstock(pf = 0, pm = 0, fage = c(5, 10)) %>%
  trim(year = 1955:2022)

# hindcast with fbar = 0.3 (~ Fmsy)
hind <- fwd(fls,
            sr = rec(fls)[, ac(1956:2022)],
            control = fwdControl(year = 1956:2022,
                                 value = 0.3,
                                 quant = "fbar"))



# take the first 5 years as a seed
stk <- fls %>% trim(year = 1955:1959)
rec <- rec %>% trim(year = 1960:2022)
f_age_proxy <- 7.03
for(y in 1960:2022) {

  yc.last <- as.character(y - 1)

  yc <- as.character(y)
  print(yc)

  last.year <- range(stk)["maxyear"][[1]]
  this.year <- last.year + 1
  current.catch <- catch(stk) %>% last()
  amean <-
    catch.n(stk)[, yc.last] %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    filter(age >= 5) %>%
    summarise(x = sum(age * data) / sum(data)) %>%
    pull(x)
  f <- amean / f_age_proxy
  bio <- computeStock(stk) %>% as.vector() %>% rev()
  b2 <- mean(bio[1:2])
  b3 <- mean(bio[3:5])
  r <- b2/b3

  m <- 0.5
  next.advice <- r * m * f * current.catch
  next.advice <- min(max(0.7 * current.catch, next.advice), 1.2 * current.catch)
  # note: should really take the "real" weights
  proj <- stf(stk, nyears = 1, wts.nyears = 1)
  ctrl <-
    fwdControl(data.frame(year = this.year,
                          quant = "catch",
                          value = next.advice))
  stk <- fwd(proj, control = ctrl, sr = rec[,yc])

}


plot(FLStocks(spaly = fls, hind = hind, dls23 = stk)) +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_line(lwd = 1) +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1")

# What is the age based proxy for "f"
catch.n(hind) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  filter(year %in% seq(1955, 2020, by = 5)) %>%
  select(year, age, oC = data) %>%
  ggplot(aes(age, oC, group = year)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ year)

catch.n(stk) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  filter(year > 1970) %>%
  select(year, age, oC = data) %>%
  mutate(yc = year - age) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(p = oC / sum(oC, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(age) %>%
  mutate(p = mean(p, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(age, p)) +
  geom_line()

catch.n(stk) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  # age at first capture
  filter(age >= 4)


catch.n(hind) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  select(year, age, oC = data) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(p = oC / mean(oC, na.rm = TRUE),
         yc = factor(year - age)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(year, p, fill = yc)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_grid(age ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")



oC <-
  catch.n(stk) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  select(year, age, oC = data) %>%
  mutate(yc = year - age)

oC %>%
  group_by(yc) %>%
  mutate(p = oC / sum(oC)) %>%
  ungroup(yc) %>%
  filter(yc %in% 1970:2005) %>%
  ggplot(aes(age, p, group = yc)) +
  geom_line()


oC %>%
  filter(age >= 5) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(mage = sum(age * oC) / sum(oC)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(year, mage)) +
  geom_line() +
  expand_limits(y = 0)
f_age_proxy <-
  oC %>%
  filter(age >= 5) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(mage = sum(age * oC) / sum(oC)) %>%
  pull(mage) %>%
  mean()

```
